items.question: What are Jovana Nogic's stats?
items.answer: In the 2026 regular season, Jovana Nogic averaged 10.4 points, 1.1 rebounds, and 1.6 assists in 16 games for the Phoenix Mercury.

items.question: How tall is Jovana Nogic?
items.answer: The WNBA lists Jovana Nogic at 6 feet.

items.question: Was Jovana Nogic drafted?
items.answer: No. Jovana Nogic was not drafted into the WNBA. She played at Providence from 2015 to 2019 and left as the program's all-time leader in three-pointers made.

items.question: What team does Jovana Nogic play for?
items.answer: Jovana Nogic plays for the Phoenix Mercury. 2026 was her first WNBA season, and she shot 42.1% from three in 16 games.

items.question: Has Jovana Nogic played in the Olympics?
items.answer: Yes. Jovana Nogic helped Serbia reach the quarterfinals of the 2024 Paris Olympics, averaging 12.3 points and 4.5 assists while shooting 43.5% from three. She captains Serbia's national team.
